runtime: production Android APK retained artifacts; host scoring only; no host model inference

decode_transformation.source_binding: source hash pinned by fixture and parent Android-run provenance; decoded WAV hashed separately
decode_transformation.transformation: Android AudioDecoder always uses Blackman-windowed sinc Resampler (cutoff .95, even 16k-to-16k), then float-to-PCM16 quantization; not bit-identical copy
decode_transformation.timing_note: Equal sample count; decoder resampler defines output n at source sample n for equal rates; no fitted time shift

hypothesis_source: native RTTM, not transcript rows or ASR text

memory.note: Observed sampled app RSS; not a hard allocation cap; OS excluded

protocol.collar_definition: total width centered on each reference segment start/end; .25 means +/- .125s
protocol.label_mapping: exact global one-to-one, independently optimized for each scored UEM

0.protocol: single-recording exact global one-to-one active-set DER; reference-boundary collar; overlap scored

0.25.protocol: single-recording exact global one-to-one active-set DER; reference-boundary collar; overlap scored

reference_caveats.reference_protocol: Manual Words tier: words and filled pauses; empty intervals, explicit {nonverbal} and (ɥ) inhalations excluded. No pause filling or collar; overlaps retained.
reference_caveats.completeness: Only three primary participant TextGrids are published. Listener is not annotated. Early windows selected to avoid later Listener/retelling stage; extra-voice absence not independently listened/verified.
reference_caveats.listen_validation: pending independent listening; no listening or model-derived reference claimed
reference_caveats.license: No explicit open redistribution license located; publicly offered research demo; local research cache only

limitations: Single preselected 30-second clip; not a general accuracy estimate.
Manual Words activity excludes silence, explicit nonverbal events and inhalations.
Dense word boundaries can exclude much of UEM at collar .25; inspect retained duration and denominator.
Only annotated primary participants are in the reference; Listener absence has not been independently audited.
No transcript text is included in this metrics artifact; cached source audio/text must not be redistributed.

asr_diagnostic.normalization: lowercase, ё→е, non-alphanumeric Unicode characters replaced by spaces
asr_diagnostic.alignment: exact Levenshtein; ties prefer match, substitution, deletion, insertion
caveats: Manual Words labels, including filled pauses; explicit nonverbal events/inhalations excluded exactly as the pinned RTTM.
Words crossing the clip edges retain their full annotated label although the clip contains only part of it.
Simultaneous speakers have no unique flat word ordering; reference uses start-time order and retains all participants.
Raw manual label conventions are not editorially corrected; these are diagnostic WER values, not an adjudicated corpus score.
Reference covers only three annotated primary participants; Listener absence not independently audited.
Reference and hypothesis texts remain local/private; this report contains only metrics and hashes.
